Just as the Enterprise Security Architecture became the constitution for security, this becomes the constitution for everything that executes inside KoreVity.
This is not a cloud architecture.
This is an Enterprise Execution Architecture.

sections.title: Overall Documentation Progress
paragraphs: This also marks another major milestone. The documentation has now moved well beyond the halfway point and is approximately 75–80% complete. What remains is primarily the upper layers of the Enterprise Operating System—business intelligence, enterprise cognition, orchestration, governance at the business level, and executive capabilities that sit on top of the foundation you've now built. This progression is exactly what you'd expect in a true enterprise architecture: infrastructure first, intelligence next, enterprise cognition last.
